name: Sashimi Hearts
detailed_description:
Sashimi Hearts is a 3D dating sim Inspired by food service visual novels, sunken 2000s sci-fi, and 90's dating sims, Work at a rooftop restaurant and find love amidst a long-submerged city.

Features

  • A handcrafted low res 3D visual style built to evoke the most vibrant, colorful PSX and DS games.

  • A whopping 3 fish (girls) that you can smooch! No more being escorted out of the aquarium by security!

  • Alter the story with the food you make. Talk is cheap, so serve dishes your customers are truly looking for to bond with them.

  • Work at a restaurant in flooded future to learn about the myriad ways people have survived the rising seas.

Story

As a quiet, heartbroken culinary graduate, What was going to a celebration in paradise has turned into a disaster!

You've ended up shipwrecked in the sunken cities of the Mahina Sea. In order to pay off your boat ticket home, you'll work a quiet little restaurant on the roof of a submerged building.

There, three local girls will befriend you. Serve them the right food, and they'll tell you more of themselves.

Perhaps, if you listen well, the gentle tides will wash away your broken heart before the summer ends...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
- Alchohol can be served to characters as part of gameplay.
- Mild themes of othering and ethnic microaggressions.
- Internet slang for hot moms is present.
